title: jmap-client: implement request.rs (JmapRequestBuilder)
description: Implement crate-jmap-client/src/request.rs by extracting JmapRequestBuilder and AccountInfo from crate-jmapchat-client/src/jmap.rs, dropping all type definitions that duplicate jmap-types, and including only the base RFC 8620 Session fields (no Chat-extension fields).
design: jmapchat-client/src/jmap.rs redefines Id, UTCDate, JmapRequest, JmapResponse, Invocation, ResultReference, Session from scratch — all now come from jmap-types, delete them. Keep: JmapRequestBuilder (with add_call method updated for Invocation tuple shape), AccountInfo. Session struct: include only RFC 8620 §2 fields: capabilities (map of capability URN → object), accounts (map of accountId → AccountInfo), primaryAccounts (map of capability URN → accountId), username, apiUrl, uploadUrl, downloadUrl, eventSourceUrl, state. DO NOT include any jmap-chat extension fields — those belong in jmap-chat-client's AccountInfo extension or a separate ChatSession wrapper. Capability structs: keep only WebSocketCapability (RFC 8887). ChatCapability and any jmap-chat-specific capability structs move to jmap-chat-types or jmap-chat-client.
